turn.question: Which vendor is cheapest on the full 30-line basket?
turn.answer:
Comparing vendors on the full 30-line basket is not straightforward because some vendors did not bid on every line. 

*   **Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd.**, **Bhiwandi Corrugated Industries LLP**, and **Ganesh Kraft Traders** priced all 30 lines. Among them, **Bhiwandi Corrugated Industries LLP** has the lowest total (59,708,854 INR).
*   **Sahyadri Boxes & Sheets** and **Nakoda Paper Packs** did not provide quotes for every line (27/30 and 29/30 lines, respectively), so their totals are partial and not directly comparable to the 30-line vendors.

Because coverage varies, the like-for-like comparison (which I provided previously) is the most accurate way to rank them. For a fair, full-basket view, you would need to address the missing quotes from Sahyadri and Nakoda.
